release_notes: One-click Quick Publish now bumps the patch version, rolls the changelog, tags the release and publishes it to GitHub automatically
changelog: v3.1.5 (2026-09-25): One-click Quick Publish now bumps the patch version, rolls the changelog, tags the release and publishes it to GitHub automatically — no manual version edit or changelog step
Previous (v3.1.3): Fixes ProSelect's Add Payment / Review Orders windows sometimes staying open after a payment plan was written, blocking the album reload needed to show the new payment lines

Previous (v3.1.2): Fixes GHL reporting 'API Key Invalid' with a stale saved key, fixes log-upload 401 errors by moving all uploads to one verified Gist token, and shows the rejected key's fingerprint on failed permission tests
